title: Show user-facing error feedback on the StateError path in TutoredChildrenSection._fireEntryPullAndNavigate
why: The permissionDenied and error branches of the preceding switch both show a ScaffoldMessenger snackbar so the user learns why they didn't land in the talmid view. The `on StateError catch` block three lines later only logs via AppLogger and calls exit()+dismissLoading() — no snackbar, no dialog. If buildTutoredPullServiceFromWidget throws (documented as the 'non-cloud accounts' case), the user taps a tutored-child row, watches the loading spinner, and it disappears with zero explanation — indistinguishable from a silent hang.
recommendation: Add the same ScaffoldMessenger snackbar pattern (with an AppLocalizations-backed message) to the StateError catch block.
acceptance_criteria: A widget test stubs the pull service to throw StateError and asserts a SnackBar/error message appears
The StateError catch block gives feedback consistent with the permissionDenied/error branches
